caption: The drawing depicts a single object, a fireplace bellows, oriented horizontally with the nozzle pointed to the right. The bellows have a round, bulbous main body decorated with green and yellow floral patterns, with the dominant color being green, accentuated by yellow and mustard designs. The main body is attached to wooden handles on the left, which are colored green and connected at the end with a cord or leather strap. The expandable part of the bellows is a light brown, leather-like material, secured to the wooden body with evenly spaced, round brass or gold-colored rivets. The nozzle at the right end of the bellows is metallic and gold in color, tapering to a narrow, rounded tip. The background of the image is plain and beige, with no additional objects or patterns, and the artist’s name, "FLORENCE MILITZ," is visible near the nozzle.
title: Bellows
